passage:
For Mother's Day, Eric tried to bake a cake. He read the recipe too quickly and added salt instead of sugar.
The cake looked beautiful, but the first bite was terrible. Eric wanted to throw it away before his mother came home.
His father tasted it and made a face. Then he said, "At least it is memorable."
When Eric's mother came home, he told her the truth. She laughed and hugged him. They bought ice cream and ate it with fruit instead.
Eric felt disappointed, but his mother said the effort mattered more than the cake.
The salty cake became a family joke. Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, "Did you check the sugar"
